package.name: dummy_vlm
package.description:
Launch-only compatibility shim. The module itself is the `vlm` package next door; this one exists so that `ros2 launch dummy_vlm dummy_vlm.launch` — the command the challenge's own docker/README.md documents, in a file outside ai_module/ that a submission may not edit — still starts it. There is no code here, only a launch file that includes `vlm`'s.
Delete this package only once nothing outside ai_module/ names it.
